name: NeRF with Local Neural Fields (Nerflets)
definition: A set of local neural radiance fields that together represent a scene, where each nerflet maintains its own spatial position, orientation, and extent, contributing to panoptic, density, and radiance reconstructions within that region.
summary: Nerflets represent 3D scenes as local neural fields optimized via 2D supervision, enabling efficient, scalable, and editable reconstruction without expensive 3D ground-truth data.
